title: Gondola: Grounded Vision Language Planning for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2506.11261v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in robotic manipulation. However, directly mapping visual observations and language instructions to low-level actions often results in limited interpretability and weak robustness in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address these challenges, we employ a modular manipulation framework that separates high-level planning from low-level control. At its core is Gondola, a grounded vision-language planning model that generates structured plans with explicit pixel-level object grounding before action execution. Given multi-view observations and planning history, Gondola predicts the next-step plan as interleaved textual instructions and multi-view segmentation masks corresponding to target objects and goal locations. translated_title: Gondola：面向机器人操作的接地式视觉语言规划
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域已展现出可喜的进展。然而，直接将视觉观察和语言指令映射为低层动作，往往导致可解释性有限，且在复杂的长时程任务中鲁棒性较弱。为应对这些挑战，我们采用一种模块化的操作框架，将高层规划与低层控制分离开来。该框架的核心是 Gondola——一个具备视觉定位能力的视觉语言规划模型，它在动作执行之前生成带有显式像素级目标定位的结构化规划。给定多视角观测和规划历史，Gondola 以交错的文本指令和多视角分割掩码的形式预测下一步规划，其中分割掩码对应于目标物体和目标位置。为训练 Gondola，我们构建了合成数据集，为短时程的接地规划、多视角指代表达等提供显式监督……
tldr: 提出Gondola视觉语言规划模型，通过在执行动作前生成带像素级目标定位和多视角分割掩码的结构化规划，将高层规划与低层控制解耦，显著提升了复杂长时程机器人操作任务的可解释性与鲁棒性。
